About PULSE

Technology should
help work feel
more human.

PULSE is a frontend product concept built around a simple belief: useful wellbeing insights require trust, context, and firm privacy boundaries.

01

Awareness without surveillance

Personal activity timing can help people understand their own rhythm. It should never become a way to watch their screen, read their keystrokes, or score their worth.

02

Signals before emergencies

Anonymous weekly check-ins make it easier to notice sustained changes in stress and workload—and start a supportive conversation earlier.

03

Privacy people can explain

No dark patterns. Managers see aggregates only, groups below five responses disappear, and every part of the product explains what is tracked.
